name: PersonQA
intro: PersonQA 是 OpenAI 系统卡披露的内部人物事实问答评测，包含 18 类人物事实，用公开可得的人物事实衡量模型对已尝试答案的准确率与幻觉率。OpenAI 未公开样本量、类别名称、来源选择、标注协议、评分器、数据或代码。

eval_feature: 已尝试答案准确率, 幻觉率, 18类人物事实, 参考事实时效性审计
scale: 18类人物事实, 样本总量未公开
build_method_en: Public person-fact QA, 18 fact categories, construction and annotation details not disclosed
eval_feature_en: Attempted-answer accuracy, hallucination rate, 18 person-fact categories, reference-freshness audit
intro_en: PersonQA is an internal person-fact QA evaluation disclosed in OpenAI system cards. It covers 18 categories of publicly available facts about people and measures accuracy on attempted answers plus hallucination rate. OpenAI has not released its item count, category names, source-selection procedure, annotation protocol, grader, data, or code.
scale_en: 18 person-fact categories; total item count not disclosed
drawio_review_note: Aligned only with official OpenAI system-card disclosures, without inventing a standalone paper or dataset pipeline. OpenAI states that PersonQA contains questions and publicly available facts about people, spans 18 categories of person facts, and measures accuracy on attempted answers and hallucination rate. The system cards do not disclose item counts, category names, source selection, collection dates, refresh cadence, annotation or adjudication procedures, prompts, parsers, graders, splits, data, or code. The diagram marks each of those components as not disclosed. It also preserves the official warning that stale reference facts can overstate hallucination because a model may provide a current correct answer that differs from an outdated test set.
